project.name: Flight Delay Predictor
project.description: AI-powered flight delay prediction and analytics platform. Predicts delay probability using XGBoost + Random Forest ensemble model. Dashboard with interactive charts for route, weather, time analysis.

frontend.styling: Vanilla CSS (custom dark theme design system)

database.summary: App luu thong tin chuyen bay (flight_number, airline, route, thoi gian, thoi tiet, delay status). 50K sample flights generated.

database_schema.summary: 3 bang chinh: flights (du lieu chuyen bay), airlines (hang bay), airports (san bay)

tables.name: flights
tables.description: Du lieu chuyen bay voi thong tin delay, thoi tiet, khoang cach

tables.name: airlines
tables.description: Danh sach hang bay (AA, DL, UA, WN, B6, AS, NK, F9, VN, VJ)

tables.name: airports
tables.description: San bay (JFK, LAX, ORD, ATL, DFW, DEN, SFO, MIA, BOS, SEA, SGN, HAN, DAD)

database_schema.relationships_explained: 1 airline co nhieu flights, 1 airport la origin hoac destination cua nhieu flights

api_endpoints.explained: Kiem tra server con song khong
Lay danh sach chuyen bay (phan trang)
Thong ke tong quan: tong flights, ty le delay, delay trung binh
Phan tich delay theo tuyen bay (top N)
Phan tich delay theo thoi tiet (Clear, Rain, Snow...)
Phan tich delay theo thoi gian (gio, ngay, thang)
Upload file CSV de import du lieu chuyen bay
Tao 50K chuyen bay mau va import vao DB
Du doan xac suat delay cho 1 chuyen bay
Du doan delay cho nhieu chuyen bay cung luc (max 50)
Train model ML tu du lieu trong DB
Xem do chinh xac va thong tin model

feature_engineering: hour, day_of_week, month, is_weekend, is_peak_hour, quarter, season
weather encoded: Clear=0, Cloudy=1, Rain=2, Fog=3, Snow=4

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: KPI cards + 4 interactive charts (route bar, weather pie, monthly area, hourly bar)

features.name: ML Prediction
features.description: Form input -> XGBoost+RF ensemble -> delay probability + confidence

features.name: Data Management
features.description: CSV upload, sample generator, model training, paginated data table

features.name: API Analytics
features.description: 14 REST endpoints for flights, analytics, prediction

patterns: React hooks pattern: useApi<T>(url, defaultValue) for all data fetching
FastAPI async pattern: SQLAlchemy async sessions with dependency injection
ML singleton pattern: FlightDelayPredictor class with lazy model loading
Batch DB insert: 5000 rows/batch for large CSV imports
gotchas: Windows PowerShell needs Set-ExecutionPolicy Bypass for npx/npm
Unicode print in Python on Windows console needs ASCII fallback
datetime-local HTML input needs format conversion for API (T -> space)
conventions: Dark theme design system with CSS variables (--bg-primary, --accent-blue, etc.)
API response format: { success: bool, data: T, message: string }
All pages import Header component with title/subtitle
CSS file: 950+ lines organized by component sections
